fields.title: PDFs convert again: the EPUB converter uses pdf-parse 2's API
fields.description: Every PDF fails to open: the EPUB converter calls pdf-parse 1's API on the installed pdf-parse 2, and never sets the `DOMMatrix` global. Move the one working PDF read into a shared helper, use it from both callers, show the converter's own user message, and add a test that loads the real package.
fields.notes: Created by roadmap review 2026-10-14. BUG-190. Full Spec by roadmap review 2026-10-22 (U9/U10 pass): the root cause was found in the owner's `error.log` and reproduced. `pdfToEpub` calls pdf-parse 1's API, but pdf-parse 2 is installed and needs a `DOMMatrix` global. A v2-API probe converted BUG-190's PDF. Seq 9, beside ELECTRON-42-UPGRADE-1 (file-disjoint).
